Passenger removed from IndiGo flight after touching emergency exit

A passenger was deboarded from an IndiGo flight at Hyderabad airport after touching an emergency exit handle, which triggered an alarm. The flight was scheduled to depart for Kadapa. The incident involved the passenger accidentally triggering the emergency exit alarm.
